profile.business_use_case: Automatic transcription and summarization of internal and client meetings, with action items posted to Slack and Salesforce.

evidence.question_text: Does the vendor train models using customer data?
evidence.quote: SampleAI may also use customer meeting content, including transcripts, to train and improve our machine learning models.

evidence.question_text: Is data retention unbounded (no defined limit)?
evidence.quote: Meeting transcripts and derived summaries are retained for the life of the account and are not subject to a fixed deletion schedule.

evidence.question_text: Can customers request deletion of their data?
evidence.quote: Customers may request deletion of their account data at any time by submitting a request through the in-product privacy console or by emailing privacy@sampleai.example.

evidence.question_text: Is there a contractual data residency commitment?
Is data storage location unclear or offshore without a stated safeguard?
Are subprocessors that receive data disclosed?
evidence.quote: SampleAI engages the following subprocessors: Amazon Web Services (cloud hosting), Stripe (billing), Twilio (notifications), and a third-party large language model provider for summarization.

evidence.question_text: Is data encrypted at rest and in transit?
evidence.quote: All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.

evidence.question_text: Are role-based access controls available?
evidence.quote: SampleAI provides role-based access control with four predefined roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer) and supports custom role definitions on the Enterprise tier.

evidence.question_text: Does the vendor support SSO and MFA?
evidence.quote: Single sign-on is available via SAML 2.0 and OIDC, and multi-factor authentication can be enforced organization-wide by administrators.

evidence.question_text: Does the vendor perform regular penetration testing?
evidence.quote: We engage an independent security firm to perform penetration testing of the SampleAI platform annually.

evidence.question_text: Is a security incident notification process defined?
evidence.quote: In the event of a confirmed security incident affecting customer data, we will notify affected customers without undue delay and in any case within 72 hours of confirming the incident.

evidence.question_text: Does the vendor have a current SOC 2 report?
evidence.quote: SampleAI maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering the Security and Availability trust services criteria.

evidence.question_text: Does the vendor grant customer audit rights?
evidence.quote: SampleAI does not permit customer-conducted audits or on-site assessments of our infrastructure.

evidence.question_text: Does the vendor notify customers of material model changes?
evidence.quote: Customers receive at least 30 days notice before any material change to the underlying models used for summarization, including a change of model provider.

evidence.question_text: Can sensitive information appear in AI outputs?
Are AI actions logged and monitored?
evidence.quote: Administrative actions and assistant activity — including summaries generated, messages posted, and tasks created — are recorded in an audit log retained for 12 months.

evidence.question_text: Is human approval required for important/consequential AI decisions?
evidence.quote: No. Once an integration is authorized, the assistant posts summaries and creates tasks automatically without per-action confirmation.

evidence.question_text: Does the vendor state protections against prompt injection?
Can the AI access other systems or perform actions beyond generating text?
evidence.quote: The assistant can post summaries to Slack channels and create follow-up tasks in connected systems on your behalf.

evidence.question_text: Does the vendor test models for bias or fairness issues?
Does the vendor provide explanations or confidence signals for AI outputs?

recommendation: Conditional approval for internal, non-confidential meetings only. Vendor must contractually disable model training on customer data and provide a current SOC 2 Type II report before use is expanded to client meetings. Re-assess at renewal or on any material model change.
